verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce manages agent payment mandates and purchase intents, so versioning or rolling back those instructions is a fair question to ask. However, the evidence shows no versioning, review history, or rollback capability. Cancelling a purchase intent is a one-off revocation, which is an adjacent control and not versioned rollback, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
